method: Baskets are LongX vaults (ERC-20 shares whose USDG goes to the Lighter bridge, found by the perps scan) named as a basket, nexus or index and not as a leveraged single-asset vault. Value is share supply at the share's on-chain price; the legs themselves sit on Lighter and are not visible on this chain. Pools are every Uniswap v4 pool with the basket on either side since 1 Oct 2026; launches are those carrying LONG's hook. Swaps and volume are counted per complete UTC day on the basket's side, at today's share price. Launches by quote are read from LONG's launcher: each launch's quote token and the wallet that launched it. A wallet with 15 or more launches in a UTC day is counted as scripted and shown apart; the AI-against-basket comparison uses the rest.

lighter.method: Read from Lighter's public API for its Robinhood Chain deployment (api.rh.lighter.xyz): each basket's account, found by the basket token's address, with its open positions, and the AI perp market's open interest, 24-hour volume, mark and index prices. Weights are each leg's position value over the sum of all legs' absolute values; gross leverage is that sum over the account's equity. Live NAV is account equity over the basket's share supply; proven NAV is the navPerToken the vault publishes on chain in RequestSettled at each mint or redeem. Premium is the basket's on-chain pool price over live NAV.
